question: How sensitive are frozen rank-target IC and top-outcome improvements to serial dependence and multiplicity?

scope: 28 era/level/cohort/method groups per horizon x raw/momentum baselines x IC/top metrics =112 comparisons per horizon; primary20, secondary60
